source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Muster armies as usual, except:

- **EPIC HERO** units, datasheets limited to 1 per army, Enhancements and anything else allowed once per army may appear only once across the team's 2 armies.
- An Upgrade may repeat within 1 army as usual, but not appear in both armies, even with identical detachments.
- Each team names 1 **CHARACTER** model in either army as its **WARLORD**.
- Each team chooses 1 Force Disposition card that either army can use and records it on its roster.

Teammates may use the same or different faction keywords and detachments; Terminology and the Core Rules changes explain the effects. Then complete the remaining steps.

appliesTo: datasheets limited to one per army
